findings.title: Preserve trace IDs in completion logs
findings.body: `logRequest` no longer adds the `traceID` field that it previously extracted from the request context. The new contextual logger middleware adds endpoint, plugin, datasource, and user attributes, but not the trace ID, so `grafana-data-egress` completion logs lose their direct correlation with distributed traces. Preserve the trace ID as a log field or contextual attribute.

findings.title: Keep contextual test logs observable
findings.body: `FromContext` returns a new `TestLogger` with separate log fields. `LoggerMiddleware` now writes through `m.logger.FromContext(ctx)`, so when a test injects a `TestLogger` and checks that instance, the completion log is recorded only on this discarded child and the test sees no call. Return the same logger or share log storage between contextual instances.
